name: devflow
description: Rob's Claude Code workflow on top of Matt Pocock's skills and pstack: picks the right flow for a task (feature, bug, big job, small change), runs each step's skill, and proves the result. Includes a git safety hook.

git_guard.title: Git safety hook
git_guard.description: Block git push, reset --hard, clean -f, branch -D, and commands that discard the whole working tree while a devflow flow is running. You run those yourself.

no_comments.title: No code comments
no_comments.description: Claude adds no comments or docstrings to code it writes or edits, including ones that explain the change, unless you ask. Existing comments stay.

adversarial_review.title: Multi-model review
adversarial_review.description: When the feature flow adds /interrogate after code review. risky changes: auth, data, money, concurrency, migrations, public APIs. always: every feature. never: skip it.

small_changes.title: Small changes
small_changes.description: How the small-change flow works. poteto-mode: run pstack's /poteto-mode, which uses far more tokens and may spawn subagents. direct: make the change, run the related tests, and show the diff.

after_session.title: Session review
after_session.description: Which review /devflow:wrap runs. retro: Matt's /retro, one pass that suggests changes to checks, standards, and docs. reflect: pstack's /reflect, three parallel reviewers that edit your skills.
